stage1.impression: A clean, competent three-quarter of a blue acrylic horn speaker on a blue-tinted sweep. The silhouette reads and the tinted glass has real depth, but the frame is monochrome, the base has no weight where it meets the floor, a hard white vertical line on the cabinet's front-right edge looks like a glitch, and the horn throat is a crushed black blob. Smeary denoiser blotches in the horn and the lining say proof render. It reads as good CG, not a photograph.

blocking_9: A visible contact shadow along the whole front and left base edge: the floor within 10 px of the base darker than the floor 60 px away (now it is brighter: 207 at the front edge and 229 at the left, against 187)
The sweep evenly graded: top-left corner within 30 levels of top-right (now 162 vs 226), and no bright floor patch (233) left of the base that pulls the eye away from the product
The compression driver at the horn throat shows its form (a rim highlight and a separable body) instead of 52% crushed pixels
No hard, uniform specular strips: the front-right vertical edge highlight graded and below about 180 median, not a 200+ line of constant brightness
No denoiser smearing on the horn walls or the lining (final-sample render, grain doing the texture)
Cover cloth and lining reading as textile (out of scope here, but it holds the image under 9)

defects.what: No contact shadow under the front edge: floor reads 207, brighter than open floor at 187; the speaker hovers
Floor beside the left base edge is the brightest ground in frame (229); no occlusion where the cabinet stands
Bright floor band (233) on the left, a hot spot competing with the base
Long soft dark smudge (132 to 152) of cast shadow on the sweep right of the base, detached from the base itself
Top-left of the sweep a dingy grey (162) against 226 top-right: a strong diagonal gradient that reads as uneven paper
Hard white vertical line on the front-right edge (median 201, step 138 levels over 11 px): reads as a pasted stroke, not a glass edge
Compression driver crushed: 52% of pixels at black, median 2; no form
Painterly denoiser blotches and streaks inside the horn walls
Lining batts read as smooth pale-blue boxes with denoise smear (shader out of scope; noise is in scope)
Woofer cover reads as a flat blue plastic disc, no cloth weave (out of scope)
Monochrome: product, sweep and shadows all the same blue family; the product's tint does not separate from the paper's tint

changes.problem: The speaker does not stand: no contact darkening along its front and left base edges.

evidence.measured: lum_median 207 just below the front edge vs 187 open floor; left edge strip [60,880,98,940] 229

changes.expected: A tight dark core line under every base edge fading over about 20 px into the floor; front strip near 160, left strip near 180.

changes.problem: The sweep is unevenly lit: a grey top-left, a hot floor patch left of the base and a detached shadow smudge on the right.

change.to: wall aimed at [-2.6, 5.0, 2.4] 1.4 W/m2 (lift the upper left); wash moved to [0.4, -1.4, 3.0], 1.3 W/m2 (cool the floor left of the base); lights.paper power 150 to 110 W

changes.expected: Top-left and top-right of the sweep within 30 levels; floor left of the base no brighter than the floor in front.

changes.problem: A hard white uniform line on the cabinet's front-right vertical edge reads as a stroke.

evidence.measured: median 201, p95 231, edge step 138 levels over 11 px, near-constant top to bottom

change.to: area [0.06, 1.2] m, power 0.2 W (wider and dimmer, so it grades with the 20 mm edge instead of clipping a line)

changes.expected: The edge glows as a graded glass edge, median about 150 to 175, brighter mid-height, falling off top and bottom.

changes.problem: The compression driver at the horn throat is a crushed black hole with no form.

change.to: irradiance 1.0 W/m2, specular 0.8, position [1.4, -1.6, 1.75] (higher, so the driver's rim and magnet catch a specular line through the horn's mouth)

changes.expected: The driver's rim and body separate; crushed area under 25% of the throat region while the driver still reads black.

changes.problem: Denoiser blotches and streaks in the horn walls and the lining say render.

evidence.measured: seen at 2x crop: painterly smears along the horn's left wall; region lum_range 69 in large flat patches

change.to: 512 for the final (and check at full size, not the half proof); keep finish grain 1.0 so texture comes from grain not denoise

changes.expected: Smooth graded horn walls with fine grain and no blotches.

changes.problem: The tinted acrylic has little transmitted glow onto the floor, so the product's colour never lands on its setting.

evidence.measured: floor right-front of the base 194, r/g/b 176/197/210, same hue as open floor; no coloured caustic or blue bloom

change.to: az -70 el 30 at 1.5 m, irradiance 5.0 (more light through the cabinet from behind-left so blue transmission falls onto the floor in front-right)

changes.expected: A faint blue-tinted pool on the floor right-front of the base, b minus r larger there than on open floor.

changes.problem: The paper is the same blue family as the speaker, so the frame is monochrome and the product's tint does not separate.

evidence.measured: sweep r/g/b 206/230/244 vs cabinet front 26/98/146: same hue, only value differs; sweep delta_e to #D3E0E9 4.6

change.to: #DDE2E4 (keep a whisper of tint, much less chroma; the same rule, less chroma, applied to all eight colourways)

changes.expected: Paper reads as pale cool grey; the speaker becomes the only saturated blue in frame.

changes.problem: Too much dead space above the horn and too little floor in front for a tall colour card.

evidence.measured: product spans y 248 to 948 of 1080: 23% empty above, 12% below

change.to: -0.015 (product drops about 40 px in the proof; more floor and contact in frame, less empty sweep above)

changes.expected: Roughly equal margins above the horn and below the base.

out_of_scope.request: Give the woofer cover a visible cloth weave and soft edge
out_of_scope.why: It reads as a flat blue plastic disc; the cover's cloth is being reworked elsewhere.

out_of_scope.request: Give the lining batts and voile sleeves fibre and folds
out_of_scope.why: They read as smooth pale-blue boxes; the lining shaders are being reworked elsewhere.
